author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Heated floors are an excellent upgrade. But it’s important to waterproof the seams, especially outside showers. I use KERDI-BAND with ALL-SET mortar to do this inside bathrooms. The embedding tools and joint compound knife are invaluable for keeping everything flat, which helps with the tile floor
